# CANDIDATE: ORB_VWAP_RIBBON_BREAK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The ORB_VWAP_RIBBON_BREAK_LONG trigger captures bullish continuation when the opening range breaks above VWAP concurrent with a bearish-to-bullish EMA ribbon flip, providing an edge on days where SPY shows intraday strength after a weak open.

## Mechanism

Entry: At the first 5‑minute bar after 09:35 ET where (1) price closes above the opening range high, (2) the close is above the session VWAP, and (3) the EMA ribbon (fast/pivot/slow) flips from bearish‑stacked to bullish‑stacked on that bar. Exit: Standard v15 TP1 (+50% profit at 2/3 qty), chandelier profit‑lock trailing 15%, runner exits on 3‑min close back into the ribbon or premium ≥ 3× entry, with a 15:50 ET time stop. Chart stop is the opening range low minus $0.50 buffer.
